limits: Host-controlled imported packets and structurally consistent forged completeness/diagnostic claims remain unverified_import, owner unknown, source unchecked, frontier_verification pending and implementation_review pending. No semantic replay, signed provenance, host/reviewer authentication or authority established.
Operator-controlled SQLite application insert/conflict behavior does not protect against arbitrary file/database writers, journal tampering, malicious triggers or schemas, disk failure or crashes.

Synthetic actual S4 output and isolated temporary SQLite files/CLI only; no duplicate live acquisition, private payload reuse, credentials, shared implementation edits, subscriptions/poll/ack consumers, outbox intake, live DB/deployment/API changes.

Metadata/raw bytes have 1 MiB bounds and strict outer/inner JSON rules. This can reject malformed/oversized collector output; no guarantee every possible S4 envelope is importable. No silent truncation observed.
Strict calendar UTC/order/interval checks validate supplied times, not trustworthy clock observations, freshness or a production policy. UTC seconds or exactly milliseconds are supported.

Structural tool/argument/scope checks and canonical bool/integer distinction do not replay nested response meaning or prove the caller actually issued reads. Partial/access errors retained pending are not deletion/correction determinations.

Raw-byte reformat conflicts under a reused capture ID are intentional; new acquisition requires new ID. Concurrency probe covers four identical CLI processes and one row, not exhaustive scheduling/locking/disk-failure states.

Full-content reply dispositions, complete correction/visibility guarantees, response semantic verification, receipt kind/artifact_kind compatibility, freshness enforcement, source/runtime/exposure/build/deployment/CI/Convex/typecheck/factual/curation/routing/API approval remain excluded.
No exhaustive malicious-environment/resource/time/memory/deep nesting/exception/security or crash audit. Passing tests establish bounded consistency only.
